issues.problem: Story overstated the source: 《北梦琐言》 says Jingzhou's candidates mostly failed (多不成名) and it was the candidates sent (天荒解) who were called 'tianhuang', not the region; 'none ever passed' was too strong.
issues.action: Reworded story to 'almost never passed' and 'its candidates were called tianhuang'; source kept.

issues.problem: Story details wrong: Zhao Zaili was a military governor; he did not 'arrange to stay' but was sent back to Songzhou for a year (复受诏居宋一岁); the levy was per person (口率钱一千), not per household.
issues.action: Corrected those details; source 《新五代史·赵在礼传》 kept.

issues.problem: Contexts 4 and 6 could be filled by 绊脚石 (gy075, same set): 'became the supermarket's / some people's ___'.
issues.action: Rewrote both to show hatred and wanting the target gone (恨不得它马上关门 / 恨不得让他闭嘴), which 绊脚石 does not carry.

issues.problem: Context 5 ('some offered ideas, some could only ___') was also filled naturally by 泼冷水 (gy009).
issues.action: Rewrote as an onlooker sneering 'I knew this would happen' while others work overtime: mockery, not discouragement.

issues.problem: bad[1].why used pinyin (gēn, hé, gěi) to name prepositions, unclear for learners.
issues.action: Rewrote in plain English (a preposition meaning 'with' / 'for'); the validator requires English text in why.
